description: This Dart file defines a Flutter widget called BookmarkScreen, which displays a grid of product cards representing bookmarked items. It uses Flutter's Scaffold, CustomScrollView, SliverPadding, SliverGrid, and custom ProductCard widgets to layout the UI. The file references model data from demoPopularProducts and navigates to a product details screen when a card is pressed.

classes.name: BookmarkScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a grid of bookmarked products using a scrollable view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the BookmarkScreen, including a grid of product cards.
